from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Financial metric data extracted from a single company report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The specific line item label (e.g., '营业总收入')")
    amount: float = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., 'CNY', '元')")
    period: str = Field(description="The time period the data covers (e.g., '2024 Q1')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
